definitions: A 1994 American drama film written and directed by Frank Darabont, based on the 1982 Stephen King novella Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption.
A critically acclaimed and widely popular film often cited as one of the greatest movies ever made.
examples: Many consider The Shawshank Redemption to be a masterpiece.
The Shawshank Redemption tells a powerful story of hope and perseverance.
